S.FORM: == Qus == u sulit nu Hulam: 和平部落 i Taoyuan a kuwan nu Kalinku ku niyazu' nu Qus. u kasalumaluma' nu Qus sa, 14 ku luma'. kumud nu kasabinawlan sa, 47 ku tademawan. kasabinawlan nu Ingcumin sa, 40 ku tademaw, pakalatu 85%. u zuma sa, cay ku Ingcumin, 7 ku tademaw, pakalatu 15%. u kasabinacadan, Tayal 79%, Amis 4%, Paiwan 2%.
